column1: # What sqlx 0.9 (sqlx-postgres 0.9.0, PgConnectOptions::from_str) read from each connection string, recorded
# 2026-11-21 by running sqlx itself, before it left the workspace (sys#382 E1). tests/parse.rs reads it; never edit
# a line: it is what sqlx did, and orch-pg-connect must keep reading every URL the same way.
# case, url, host, port, user, password, dbname, application_name, options, sslmode; tab-separated.
# case "-" is an environment with no PG* variable, the others one each (tests/parse.rs sets their PG* variables).
# <os-user> is the operating system's user (sqlx's default). Tcp("localhost") where no host is named is sqlx's
# default when no local server's socket exists (tests/parse.rs also accepts the socket's directory where one does).
